text:
elaine: Quick kickoff — EmeraldChip wants a joint perf/W + throughput benchmark for their new 'Auric' board. Goal: show 25% watt efficiency vs baseline and 2x sustained throughput for our quantized models. Who can drive kernel tuning + runbooks?
maria: I can own the partner coordination and the marketplace blurb. Need dates first.
sam: I can lead kernel tuning. propose: baseline runs (orig kernel), tuned-run1 (sched tweaks), tuned-run2 (kv-cache tweaks). short scripts + perf counters.
rocky: I'll prep the bench harness and the data collection pipeline. plan to tag runs with: env, kernel_hash, fw_ver, power_profile.
elaine: @sam @rocky add cost-per-token breakdown too — marketing likes that for the joint note.
nishant: Telemetry note — we need PMU events + wall-power sampling. emerald-eng can we get IPMI/PMBus access to the units?
emerald-eng: Yes, we can grant PMBus and BMC creds to a staging cluster. prefer creds rotated via our secure token; mari a & I can coordinate.
maria: Scheduling: partner wants public call week of Apr 6. internal dry-run week of Mar 30. ok? :calendar:
sam: Dry-run ok. I'll push a small patch for the kernel prefetch alignment by Mar 27 for testing.
rocky: Test matrix I'm expecting: models: redwood-v1 (float16), redwood-v1-quant (nf4), sequence lengths [512,1024,2048], batch sizes [1,4,8]. power sweep: p0/p1/p2.
elaine: Good. keep the numbers that show perf/W delta front-and-center. Marketing will ask for 99th perc latency too.
ci-bot: deploy:bench-harness #342 started by rocky — logs at https://ci.redwood.test/342 (live)
rocky: CI job kicking off now. sharing interim results in this thread.
sam: Note on kernel: we might fall back to user-space prefetch if kernel hooks disrupt other workloads — add fallback flag `--prefetch-mode=auto`.
emerald-eng: We'll provide FW image v1.2 and telemetry schema by EOD tomorrow. planning to keep early embargo until joint announcement is signed.
maria: I'll draft the joint announcement checklist: embargo dates, figure approvals, logo assets, marketplace listing draft. ping me for approvals.
elaine: awesome. action items: sam -> kernel patches; rocky -> harness + CI; nishant -> telemetry hook; maria -> partner comms + announcement draft. update here with short notes. :thumbsup:
